name: TV Asahi Holdings Corporation
summary: TV Asahi Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the television (TV) broadcasting business in Japan. It operates through the TV Broadcasting Business, Internet Business, Shopping Business, and Other segments. The company offers media services, subscription-based video-on-demand (SVOD) service, and TVer, a video streaming service; and regular programs, such as Jun Sanpo and Gogo mo Jun Sanpo, as well as engages in the special events and music publication business. TV Asahi Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
